headline: Launcher 0.7.5 fixes PAL crashes and adds in-game Video options
summary: Launcher 0.7.1 through 0.7.5 repair HUD drawing, Quit Game and several crashes on both Ratchet & Clank discs. The latest release fixes PAL crashes around crates and camera updates and adds Video options during play. Historical direct development continues on today's release-only master.
highlights: #13 makes RPM, DEB and MSI installations receive the correct updater payload.
0.7.4 fixes the Windows crash between Veldin and Novalis and corrects US-disc behaviour.
Crash notices now offer reports and session logs. #12's Fedora Wayland startup failure is closed after a cursor-theme fallback lands.
#14 redesigns the launcher around a game list and adds a Size Matters entry, without establishing playability.
A PAL functional-code audit still records three differing routines and many unchecked ones. US rows remain unchecked because no US oracle is available.
Linux GPU selection, Windows Godot detection and a developer-only disc switch also improve.
